title: On the Expected Maximum Deficit and the Optimal Allocation of Reserves
abstract: arXiv:2605.16448v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Let $L$ be a c\`adl\`ag net-loss process and $M_t=\sup_{0\le s\le t}L_s$. We study the distorted expected maximum deficit $$ D_g^{(t)}(u)=\int_u^\infty g\!\left(P(M_t>v)\right) d v, $$ which combines the probability and severity of liquidity shortfalls over a fixed horizon. For concave distortions, the distorted expectation of the running maximum defines a coherent process risk measure. We then introduce two implicit capital requirements: a fixed-tolerance convex measure and a proportional-tolerance coherent measure. Their ordering properties and closed-form expressions are derived for the compound-Poisson model with exponential claims. We also study reserve allocation across multiple business lines. Minimizing the sum of line-specific deficits equalizes marginal distorted ruin probabilities and, under a common increasing distortion, yields an allocation invariant to the distortion. translated_title: 关于预期最大赤字与准备金的最优配置
translated_abstract: 设 \( L \) 为一个右连左极的净损失过程，且 \( M_t = \sup_{0 \le s \le t} L_s \)。我们研究扭曲预期最大赤字 $$ D_g^{(t)}(u) = \int_u^\infty g\!\left(P(M_t > v)\right) d v, $$ 该式结合了固定时间范围内流动性短缺的概率和严重程度。对于凹扭曲函数，运行最大值的扭曲期望定义了一个一致的过程风险度量。然后，我们引入了两种隐性资本要求：一种固定容差的凸度量，以及一种比例容差的一致度量。我们推导了在复合泊松模型下具有指数索赔时这些度量的排序性质和闭式表达式。我们还研究了跨多个业务线的准备金配置。最小化各线特定赤字之和会均衡各线的边际扭曲破产概率，并且在共同的递增扭曲下，产生一个对扭曲不变的配置。最差线赤字准则产生了一种依赖结构。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于扭曲预期最大赤字的资本配置方法，证明了在特定条件下准备金分配对扭曲函数的不变性，并给出了复合泊松模型下的闭式解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a capital allocation method based on distorted expected maximum deficit, proves invariance of the allocation to distortion under common increasing distortions, and provides closed-form solutions for the compound-Poisson model.
